title.narrative: Assessment Rehabilitation and Construction of One-Stop-Shops for UNHCR

description.narrative:
UNOPS supports UNHCR, the UN Refugee Agency in the assessment, construction and rehabilitation of 27 One-Stop-Shops facilities in Gambella, Assosa, Jijiga, Shire and Melkadida. The shops will make is possible to access multiple services in one place, and Ethiopians will access the same services as refugees. This is in line with the Global Compact on Refugees, calling for more inclusion of refugees into their host communities.


A One-Stop-Shop is equipped with the latest digital registration technology together with internet connectivity to facilitate a two-way communication between persons of concern and service providers. The system is able to issue Proof of Registration documents, ID cards, and civil registration certificates immediately as soon as a request is received. It also provides refugees and local communities access to the internet to be able to seek and secure essential services.


Ethiopia hosts more than 900,000 refugees and is currently working to include refugees in national systems. These One-Stop-Shops are expected to speed up the issuance of legal identity documents for refugees and local communities, thus realising the fundamental rights of refugees and Ethiopian citizens to own valid identity documents, register their civil events, and access a range of complementary services.
